case.title: Zhongke's Oman anode plant
case.subtitle: Zhongke Electric / Zhongke Shinzoom · Sohar Freezone, Oman
case.question: Can Sayari see Zhongke Electric's planned Oman anode plant, and how does Zhongke graphite reach the US today?
case.headline: Not yet: the trail hasn't started. Sayari has no record of the Sohar plant and no shipments into or out of it. The ownership chain is half visible. Sayari's Chinese registry shows Zhongke Electric owning the anode producer, and the company's own filing names the Hong Kong subsidiary that is building the plant. Today Zhongke graphite reaches the US mostly indirectly, through Malaysian cell plants, and only rarely direct from China.
case.summary_for_non_experts: Zhongke Electric is a Chinese company and one of China's top three anode makers. It is building a 200,000-tonne-a-year anode plant in Oman. Ground was broken on 8 May 2026, and first output is due in 2027. Because no anode leaves the plant yet, there is nothing to trace, but we mapped who owns it and how the company's anode material reaches the US now. Sayari shows China's registry chain and the Hong Kong company's existence. It does not show the Hong Kong-to-Oman link, which comes from the company's own stock-exchange filing.

key_numbers.label: Sayari records for the Oman plant or its project company
planned capacity, two phases; ground broken 8 May 2026
direct China→US shipment rows from Zhongke Shinzoom entities (2021–2025)
artificial-graphite rows (HS 3801.10 or 3801.90) to two Malaysian cell plants, Apr 2025–Apr 2026
existing 'Oman→US' HS 3801 rows, mostly Indian cargo relayed through Oman: noise

steps.title: The plant isn't in the data yet
steps.text: We searched in English and Chinese for any Zhongke, Shinzoom or Sohar anode entity in Oman, and for shipments into Oman under the group's name. Nothing came back. That fits a plant that broke ground in May 2026 and won't produce until 2027. The project company named in the filing has no Sayari record, so it appears here without a Sayari ID.

steps.title: The owner: registry in China, filing beyond it
steps.text: Sayari's registry data shows Zhongke Electric holding 100% of a Xingcheng holding company, which holds 99.998% of the anode producer, Hunan Zhongke Star City Graphite. The company's June 2025 filing says that producer owns 100% of Zhongke Shinzoom (HK) Holdings, which set up the Oman project company. Sayari has the Hong Kong company (formed Nov 2024) but no path from it to Zhongke Electric.

steps.title: The groundbreaking checks out
steps.text: The 8 May 2026 groundbreaking was a single-source claim. Now the company's website, Gulf News (citing Oman's news agency), MEED, Sina Finance and Baidu all report it. The Hong Kong investor's address in the filing matches a Sayari trade record that has already shipped to a US importer, so the vehicle is already active in trade.

steps.title: Today's baseline: mostly via Malaysia
steps.text: Direct China→US rows are few: 7 to SK Battery America (2021–22), 1 to GM (Mar 2025) and 1 to Chemico (Oct 2025). Since 2025, 32 rows of artificial graphite have gone to EVE Energy Malaysia and Linergy Power. Both ship lithium-ion cells to US buyers such as Eaton, Milwaukee Tool and Briggs & Stratton. Trade data can't show whether those cells contain Zhongke graphite.

steps.title: What to watch once Sohar starts
steps.text: The 'Oman→US artificial graphite' corridor already shows 917 rows, mostly Indian chemicals and freight relayed through Omani ports. A corridor filter won't spot the new plant; a buyer must watch named shippers. Watch for: the Sohar project company or Shinzoom (HK) Holdings as shipper; HS 3801 or petroleum coke moving from Zhongke's Chinese units into Sohar; and an Omani registry record naming the Hong Kong parent.

detected.text: Registry chain inside China: Zhongke Electric → (100%) Xingcheng holding company → (99.998%) Hunan Zhongke Star City Graphite.
Zhongke Shinzoom (HK) Holdings exists (incorporated 8 Nov 2024) and, under a matching address, appears as shipper of artificial graphite from China to Chemico LLC (Oct 2025).
Current flows: 9 direct China→US rows (SK Battery America, GM, Chemico) and 32 rows to Malaysian cell plants that ship cells to US buyers.

suggested.text: The Hong Kong → Oman ownership: stated in Zhongke's filing and Gulf press, not in Sayari.
Trade records 'Hunan Zhongke Shinzoom' and 'Shinzoom (HK) Holdings' are the registry companies, matched by street address.
Malaysian route: Zhongke graphite into EVE Energy Malaysia and Linergy Power, whose cells go to US buyers. The anode content of those cells can't be shown.

not_visible.text: The Oman plant itself: no entity, no inputs and no outputs in Sayari.
Any registry link from the Hong Kong vehicle to its Chinese parent or its Omani subsidiary.
Equipment or feedstock shipments into Sohar reported in Chinese press.

passport.declared: The cell plant's location, e.g. USA or Malaysia.
passport.paper_trail: Today: Ningxiang/Changsha, China, sometimes routed through Hong Kong. From 2027: possibly Sohar, Oman.
passport.note: An Oman origin label would hide a Chinese-owned producer.

passport.paper_trail: Artificial graphite (HS 3801.10/3801.90) from Zhongke Shinzoom to Malaysian cell plants.
passport.note: Composition says what, not who made it.

passport.paper_trail: The rows we saw are artificial graphite. No natural-graphite inputs pulled.

passport.declared: Deferred under the EU Battery Regulation.
passport.paper_trail: No forced-labor flag on Shinzoom's trade record. Two sister plants carry 'owned-by' flags through a co-owner.
passport.note: Flags sit on neighbours, not on the exporter.

passport.declared: No such field in the EU passport.
passport.paper_trail: Oman plant → HK Holdings → Hunan Zhongke Star City Graphite → Zhongke Electric (filing + registry).
passport.note: The US PFE test turns on this chain; half of it is outside Sayari.

red_flags.flag: Chinese parent ownership of the transit plant
red_flags.note: Registry shows the Chinese links; the HK→Oman links come from the company filing.

red_flags.flag: Same HS imported from China and exported to the US
red_flags.note: The plant has no trade yet.

red_flags.flag: Recent incorporation vs. first export date
red_flags.note: HK vehicle formed Nov 2024; shipper on a US entry by Oct 2025 (goods from China).

red_flags.flag: Volume spike after a policy date
red_flags.note: Too few US rows to test. The Malaysian rows start in Apr 2025.

red_flags.flag: Shared address or officer with a flagged entity
red_flags.note: Watchlist hits run through index-fund and HKSCC shareholders: noise.
Trade and registry records split; a dormant 2017 HK namesake.
None on Shinzoom; 'owned-by' flags on two sister plants via a co-owner.

caveats: Building a plant abroad and processing Chinese inputs there is legal and common. Nothing here shows wrongdoing by any company named.
Buyers are named because they appear in customs records. That says nothing about their compliance.
The Hong Kong → Oman ownership comes from Zhongke's filing and press, not from a registry Sayari holds.
Address-based links between trade records and registry companies are our judgment and could be wrong.
Malaysian cell exports can't be tied to Zhongke graphite at the lot level.
Oman→US HS 3801.10 data is dominated by relayed Indian cargo and likely miscoding. Don't read the corridor as anode trade.
The US anti-dumping case named Zhongke Shinzoom entities at 93.50%, but the USITC's negative vote (Mar 2026) means no order took effect.
case.answer: The Oman plant isn't in Sayari yet. Ownership is visible inside China's registry and in the company's own filing. Today Zhongke graphite reaches the US mostly indirectly, as artificial graphite shipped to two Malaysian battery-cell plants.
case.why_it_matters: At up to 200,000 t/yr, Sohar would be one of the largest anode plants outside China. Recording its ownership now gives buyers a baseline before any 'Made in Oman' anode material appears.

entities.name: Hunan Zhongke Electric Co., Ltd. (湖南中科电气股份有限公司)
entities.summary: Shenzhen-listed group (stock 300035) that started in electromagnetic equipment and now makes anode material. Sayari's registry shows it owning 100% of the holding company above its anode producer. It records no trade itself.

entities.name: 湖南中科星城科技有限公司 (Zhongke Xingcheng holding company)
entities.summary: Intermediate holding company. Sayari shows it 100% owned by Zhongke Electric and holding 99.998% of the anode producer Hunan Zhongke Star City Graphite. The English label is ours.

entities.name: Hunan Zhongke Star City Graphite Co., Ltd. (湖南中科星城石墨有限公司)
entities.summary: The group's main anode producer in Ningxiang, Changsha; registered 2001. The company's 2025 filing names it as the 100% owner of the Hong Kong company that is building the Oman plant. Its registry record holds no trade; exports appear under the 'Hunan Zhongke Shinzoom' trade record.

entities.name: 贵州中科星城石墨有限公司 (Guizhou Zhongke Xingcheng Graphite)
entities.summary: A Guizhou anode subsidiary held directly by Zhongke Electric (share not shown in our pull). 'Guizhou Zhongke Shinzoom' entities were named in the US anti-dumping case. No trade pulled.

entities.name: HUNAN ZHONGKE SHINZOOM CO., LTD (trade record)
entities.summary: A trade-data record with no registry identifiers. Its two Changsha addresses match the group's registry addresses (No. 118 Quanzhou North Road, Ningxiang, and Building 3, Yida Smart Technology Park). It ships artificial graphite to SK Battery America, GM, two Malaysian cell makers and SK On Hungary. 62 shipment rows, 2021 to 2026.

entities.name: Zhongke Shinzoom (HK) Holdings Co., Limited (中科星城(香港)控股有限公司)
entities.summary: Hong Kong company incorporated 8 Nov 2024 and active, per Sayari's Hong Kong registry data. The company's filing says it is wholly owned by Hunan Zhongke Star City Graphite and is the direct investor in the Oman project. Sayari holds no owner or subsidiary for it, and finds no path to Zhongke Electric.

entities.name: ZHONGKE SHINZOOM (HK) HOLDINGS CO LIMITED (trade record)
entities.summary: A US-import record with no country or identifiers. Its address (Room 1406A, 14/F, Belgian Bank Building, 721-725 Nathan Road, Kowloon) is the one given for the Hong Kong holding company in Zhongke's filing. It shipped artificial graphite from China to Chemico LLC in Oct 2025.

entities.name: Zhongke Shinzoom (HK) Co., Limited (closed, 2017)
entities.summary: An older Hong Kong company with a near-identical name, registered 5 Sep 2017 and now inactive. Sayari has no relationships or trade for it. Kept separate so it isn't confused with the 2024 holding company.

entities.name: Zhongke Xingcheng Sohar New Material Technology Co., Ltd. (中科星城苏哈尔新材料科技有限公司) — not in Sayari
entities.summary: The Oman project company named in Zhongke's June 2025 filing. It is building a 200,000 t/yr anode base on Plot 3751 in Sohar Freezone, with ground broken on 8 May 2026 and first output due in 2027. Sayari has no record of it under any name we tried, so this node has no Sayari ID. The English name is our translation.

entities.name: SK Battery America
entities.summary: SK On's US cell plant in Georgia. Seven rows of artificial graphite from Hunan Zhongke Shinzoom, Aug 2021 to May 2022.

entities.name: General Motors
entities.summary: One row of artificial graphite (HS 3801.10) from Hunan Zhongke Shinzoom, arriving 2 Mar 2025. This is the most recent battery-maker row in our results.

entities.name: Chemico LLC
entities.summary: US importer. One row of artificial graphite from Zhongke Shinzoom (HK) Holdings, shipped from China and arriving 15 Oct 2025. The data doesn't show the end use.

entities.name: EVE Energy Malaysia Sdn Bhd
entities.summary: Malaysian cell plant. It received 18 rows of artificial graphite (HS 3801.10/3801.90) from Hunan Zhongke Shinzoom, Apr 2025 to Apr 2026. It ships lithium-ion cells to US buyers, including EVE Energy North America, Briggs & Stratton, Milwaukee Tool, TTI Consumer Power Tools, Stanley Black & Decker, Energizer Battery Co, ProTechnologies and ABM Tucker GA.

entities.name: Linergy Power Sdn Bhd
entities.summary: Malaysian cell maker. It received 14 rows of artificial graphite (HS 3801.10) from Hunan Zhongke Shinzoom, Sep 2025 to Feb 2026. It ships 18650/21700 lithium-ion cells and battery systems to US buyers: Eaton, Milwaukee Tool, Ampace Technology, Stanley Black & Decker and Techtronic Product Development.

entities.name: SK On Hungary Kft
entities.summary: SK On's Hungarian cell plant. One row of artificial graphite (HS 3801.10) from Hunan Zhongke Shinzoom, arriving at a Slovenian port in Mar 2023.

entities.name: Samsung SDI Co., Ltd.
entities.summary: Korean cell maker. Two rows from Hunan Zhongke Shinzoom in Dec 2021 and Jan 2022, coded HS 8543 (electrical apparatus), which looks like a coding error for anode material.

entities.name: Uni-Trans Line Co., Ltd.
entities.summary: Korean freight forwarder. It is consignee on 18 Shinzoom rows to Korea, 2022–2023, under mixed HS codes (one row describes artificial graphite). We treat it as logistics, not as an end buyer.

entities.name: Eaton Corporation
entities.summary: US buyer of lithium-ion battery systems (HS 8507.60) from Linergy Power in Malaysia: 5 rows, Aug to Sep 2026. A second Eaton record (importer number 34-0196300SK) has one more row.

entities.name: EVE Energy North America Corp
entities.summary: US arm of EVE Energy. It received 7 rows of lithium-ion cells from EVE Energy Malaysia, Jan to Jun 2026. Six of those rows left from Indonesia, not Malaysia.

entities.name: Briggs & Stratton, LLC
entities.summary: US buyer of INR21700 lithium-ion cells from EVE Energy Malaysia: 3 rows, Jul to Sep 2026. Of the two dated departures, one left from Singapore and one from China.

calls.question: Does Sayari hold any Zhongke entity in Oman?
calls.result_summary: 0 results.
calls.interpretation: No Oman entity under the group name. This is the first sign the plant isn't in the data yet.

calls.question: Which record is the listed parent?
calls.result_summary: 513 results came back (the limit was ignored) and the output was saved to a file. Among them were 湖南中科电气股份有限公司 (-jDI6N9q1MWnPT0ujf-8iw), an English-name duplicate 'HUNAN ZHONGKE ELECTRIC CO., LTD.' (Mn2FeoIt2w0McDIDjkIrxg), and Changsha, Chifeng and sales-department branches. Most hits are unrelated companies called Zhongke.
calls.interpretation: We picked the Chinese-name record because it carries a USCC and the listed-security links. The name is very common, so we parsed the results; we didn't read them by eye.

calls.question: Can one query find both romanisations?
calls.result_summary: 0 results.
calls.interpretation: The OR query with quoted phrases returned nothing, though each name exists (see s305). The query syntax didn't work as documented.

calls.question: Who does Zhongke Electric own, and what identifies it?
calls.result_summary: USCC 914306007607108300, LEI 65560006WDZK75ECJB29, SZSE 300035, registered 1999. Its listed business includes lithium-ion anode material and silicon anodes. It holds 100% of 湖南中科星城科技有限公司 and 100% of 湖南中科智造工程技术有限公司. The summary counts 31 owner_of and 11 shareholder_of links. No trade.
calls.interpretation: This is the parent. The anode business sits one level down, in the Zhongke Xingcheng holding company.

calls.question: What records use the group's English brand?
calls.result_summary: 15 results: a 'HUNAN ZHONGKE SHINZOOM CO., LTD' trade record (CHN/USA/MEX/CAN); Zhongke Shinzoom (HK) Co., Limited (HK CR 2574460); Zhongke Shinzoom (HK) Holdings Co., Limited (registry); 'ZHONGKE SHINZOOM (HK) HOLDINGS CO LIMITED' at 721-725 Nathan Road; Shinzoom Nouveau United Corp. (Montreal; one record also names Nouveau Monde Graphite); a UK 'Shinzoom Ltd'; and Chinese trademarks.
calls.interpretation: The trade-bearing records use 'Shinzoom'. The Canadian entity points to a separate Shinzoom tie-up with Nouveau Monde Graphite, which we didn't pursue. Nothing in Oman.

calls.question: Does a Chinese-name search find Xingcheng entities, including any overseas?
calls.result_summary: The call timed out.
calls.interpretation: No result. We got the same records through the downstream traversal (s307) instead.

calls.question: Does Zhongke's registry tree reach Hong Kong or Oman?
calls.result_summary: 48 entities came back, all Chinese. They include Hunan, Guizhou, Gui'an, Yunnan, Gansu and Sichuan Zhongke Xingcheng graphite companies, a Xingcheng supply-chain company and Anhui Haida. Many level-3 hits are venture holdings through 宁波科泓产业投资中心. Gui'an and Yunnan Xingcheng carry 'owned_by_usa_section_1260h_entity' flags through a co-owner, 湖南中科星城控股有限公司. No Hong Kong or Omani entity.
calls.interpretation: The registry tree stops at China's border. The Hong Kong vehicle and the Oman project company aren't linked in Sayari, so the overseas half of the chain must come from the company's filings.

calls.question: Who does the Shinzoom trade record ship to?
calls.result_summary: There are 61 sent shipments and no identifiers. Its addresses match the group's registry addresses in Ningxiang and at the Yida Smart Technology Park in Changsha. Ships_to: Linergy Power (MYS), SK On Hungary, Samsung SDI, SK Battery America, EVE Energy Malaysia, General Motors, Uni-Trans Line. It owns US, Canadian and Mexican 'SHINZOM' trademarks.
calls.interpretation: This is the group's exporting identity in trade data. Its address ties it to the registry producer (e307).

params.query: Zhongke Electric Oman Sohar anode groundbreaking May 2026

calls.question: Is the May 2026 groundbreaking real, and who is the investing entity?
calls.result_summary: GraphiteHub, Baidu Baike, Gulf News (citing ONA), MEED (via goalfore) and an Arabian Daily post all report ground broken at Sohar Freezone on 8 May 2026, with first-stage output due in 2027. Gulf News says Zhongke acted 'through its subsidiary Zhongke Xingcheng (Hong Kong)'. GraphiteHub also reports that on 12 Jun 2026 the board ended three other projects (two in China and one in Morocco) to focus on Luzhou and Oman. It also cites a 10 Sep 2026 company post on the Phase 1 frame being completed.
calls.interpretation: The 8 May 2026 groundbreaking now has several independent sources, including Omani government-linked press. It is no longer single-source. The Morocco cancellation still rests on GraphiteHub and the board notice it cites.

calls.question: What does Zhongke's own filing say about the Oman structure?
calls.result_summary: Zhongke's filing (Sina Finance bulletin) names the investor as 中科星城(香港)控股有限公司 (Zhongke Shinzoom (HK) Holdings), registration no. 77299448, at Room 1406A, 14/F, Belgian Bank Building, 721-725 Nathan Road, Mong Kok. Capital is HK$1m and its sole shareholder (100%) is 湖南中科星城石墨有限公司. The HK company sets up the Oman project company 中科星城苏哈尔新材料科技有限公司 on Plot 3751, Sohar Free Zone (356,000 m²). Investment is up to RMB 8bn, in two 100,000 t/yr parts of 36 months each. The Morocco project is deferred. Securities Times (4 Jun 2025) and aciep.net report the same chain, aciep giving Zhongke Electric's stake in the graphite company as 99.9984375%. Sina/鑫椤 and the company website (cseco.cn) confirm the 8 May 2026 start. A Sohu piece says core equipment shipped from Nantong and Shanghai to Oman.
calls.interpretation: This is the primary source for the HK→Oman links. Its HK address matches a Sayari trade record (e306). The equipment-shipment report is single-source.

calls.question: What is the Nathan Road 'Shinzoom HK Holdings' trade record?
calls.result_summary: No country and no identifiers; address Flat/Rm 1406A, 14/F, Belgian Bank Building, 721-725 Nathan Road. Its only source is USA Imports. One shipment, to Chemico LLC.
calls.interpretation: The address matches the filing's Hong Kong investor exactly, so this is likely the same company acting as seller of record (e306).

calls.result_summary: Hunan Zhongke Star City Graphite, USCC 9143010072796955X1, registered 2001-05-24, at No. 118 Quanzhou North Road, Ningxiang. Current shareholder: 湖南中科星城科技有限公司, 99.99844%. calls.question: Does Zhongke anode material ship directly from China to the US?
calls.result_summary: 9 rows. Hunan Zhongke Shinzoom → SK Battery America: 7 rows, Aug 2021 to May 2022. Hunan Zhongke Shinzoom → General Motors: 1 row, HS 3801.10, 2 Mar 2025. Zhongke Shinzoom (HK) Holdings → Chemico LLC: 1 row, 15 Oct 2025, departing China.
calls.interpretation: The direct route is thin and irregular: a 2021–22 run to SK, one GM row in 2025 and one late-2025 row via the HK vehicle. Supplier field checked on every row.

calls.question: Where else does Shinzoom graphite go? Are there third-country routes?
calls.result_summary: 62 rows. EVE Energy Malaysia 18 (HS 3801.90/3801.10, Apr 2025–Apr 2026), Linergy Power 14 (HS 3801.10, Sep 2025–Feb 2026), Uni-Trans Line 18 (Korea, 2022–23, mixed HS), SK Battery America 7, Samsung SDI 2 (HS 8543), SK On Hungary 1 (HS 3801.10, via Slovenia, Mar 2023), GM 1, Chemico 1.
calls.interpretation: Since 2025 most Shinzoom graphite in the data goes to Malaysian cell plants, not to the US. That is the main indirect route today.

calls.question: Is anything already shipping into Oman from Zhongke entities, such as equipment or feedstock?
calls.result_summary: 0 rows.
calls.interpretation: No inbound trade to Oman under the group's name. Press reports of equipment shipments (t302) don't appear in Sayari, possibly because of coverage or lag.

calls.question: What does the Oman→US artificial-graphite corridor look like before the plant opens?
calls.result_summary: 917 rows, from one data source. 916 are HS 3801.10, dated Aug 2021 to Jul 2025. Top supplier IDs are listed in s323.
